note: Verbatim rows of the hack's own Item Locations workbook (Run & Bun 1.07 documentation dump), read with polars and pinned here so scripts/build-item-locations.js is reproducible. The prose is the workbook words, unaltered; all dating is derived from it in the builder. There is no builder for this file: it is a transcription, and its source is recorded here. The copy under engines/rab/backend/DOCS has byte-identical worksheets and shared strings.
